notes.title: Power of Defense Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to Power of Defense have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Power of Defense
Fixed: Mac version: Achievements should work now
Fixed: Localization improved
Fixed: Demo version: Tutorial "Next Level" endless loading screen removed
Fixed: Mac version: New window creation every Audio settings change removed
